note: Files that must never be sent to an online provider. A match on the SHA-256 of the file (sha256: the ODB++ Design Format Specification 8.1 Update 4, OdbppSpec81U4.pdf, so that a renamed copy is refused too), on the file name or the PDF metadata (name_patterns, case-insensitive regular expressions) or on the text of the first three pages or the metadata (text_markers) is refused unless --allow-confidential is given. A file that cannot be read for the check is refused as well.
